text.offer: This world is rife with mana that has concentrated into nodes of power. Creating a link with a node will increase your maximum mana. Explore the lands of Meridian in search of as many nodes as you can find. If you wish to know which ones you have already found, ask me about your mana nodes. I can tell you which ones you have formed a link with.
text.complete: You've found all the mana nodes! Your spirit swells with power.
